sql: WITH receita AS (SELECT SUM(CAST(vlr_realizadoateperiodo AS DECIMAL)) AS total_receita FROM receita_receita WHERE ano_referencia = 2024 AND COALESCE(dsc_cateconomica, '') ILIKE '%Corrente%'), despesa AS (SELECT SUM(CAST(vlr_liquidado AS DECIMAL)) AS total_despesa FROM despesa_despesa WHERE ano_referencia = 2024 AND COALESCE(dsc_naturezadespesa, '') ILIKE '3%') SELECT (total_receita / NULLIF(total_despesa, 0)) AS isf_m FROM receita, despesa;
